segments.name: Outdoor Products
segments.description: Designs, retails and distributes premium outdoor products such as coolers, drinkware, bags and apparel to consumers and retail partners worldwide.
segments.evidence: We operate as one reportable operating segment.

revenueModel.text: YETI sells premium outdoor products to wholesale retail partners and directly to consumers through its DTC channel and retail stores.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell our products in our DTC channel to customers on our websites, through YETI Authorized on the Amazon Marketplace, as well as in our retail stores.
